{{Top|leg}}
The '''Anteru Sea''' was a large [[Ocean/Legends|ocean]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Gacerian]]. It separated the west coast of the continent [[Elto]] from the east coast of the continent [[An-Elto]].
